item.description: The Flask hook implementation has a critical bug in the route_wrapper function where it overwrites existing endpoint functions when multiple routes are registered with the same function name, causing "View function mapping is overwriting an existing endpoint function" errors.
item.contract: The hook_flask context manager must properly handle Flask route registration without overwriting existing endpoint functions. When Flask's route decorator is applied to a function, it should preserve the original function while wrapping it with the hook functionality.
